  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  MEMORIAL HEIGHTS CONFERENCE ROOM, 10TH FL, 12:00 PM

Walter Larkins, Commissioner
Austin Metoyer, Commissioner

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-52383  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Economic Development
  Commission Revolving Loan Subcommittee meeting of Thursday, October 26,
  2023.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  24-52384  Recommendation to approve the revolving loan application in the amount of
  $15,000 for Tiffany Love dba Love ‘Trine, TRL Media and Positive Magazine
  located at 3831 Atlantic Ave., Long Beach, CA 90807.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Economic Development Commission Revolving Loan Subcommittee on
non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to three minutes to make their comments unless
extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Vanessa Hall, City Clerk Specialist, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours
prior to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 570-6101.
